items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Oh, Pettiford was a copist of Jimmy Blanton.

ctx.x: Oh, Pettiford was a copist of Jimmy Blanton. Well, he was a performer. He couldn't read too well which, you know, would keep him away from -- this is the difference in when I came up, coming out of a symphony orchestra, I could read. I'm always a bridesmaid, never a bride. (Laughter) But, Pettiford started his
career copying Jimmy Blanton. Ray Brown copied Blanton but he had enough other things going for him that he developed it beyond --
